milestone: Collection — Reuse-Grid Layout Fix: Fixed-Height Horizontal Scroll Strip
slice: A real-usage follow-up delivered via screenshot, with the user's own words: 'we will need different layout. as the collection will grow the screen size will keep growing.' Root cause: _renderCollectionPicker's reuse section rendered every matching Collection entry into .wb-scene-template-grid/.wb-scene-template-card -- a plain, unbounded auto-fill CSS grid with no max-height/overflow-y cap, shared by 6 different call sites in worldBuilderApp.js -- appropriate for those other 5 (small, fixed source lists), but genuinely wrong for a Collection reuse grid, which grows every time a Theme Author adds a new asset. Since this markup sits embedded inline inside an Experience's own Image/Graphics content section in the Context Inspector, every new Collection entry permanently grew the whole Inspector panel taller. Fix, confined entirely to _renderCollectionPicker: rewritten to use four new CSS classes mirroring this codebase's own already-proven horizontal-scroll-strip precedent, the Scenes Library strip (.wb-scenes-strip/.wb-scene-strip-card) -- .wb-collection-reuse-strip (overflow-x:auto container), .wb-collection-reuse-card (fixed-width 72px, flex:0 0 auto), .wb-collection-reuse-thumb (52px thumbnail), .wb-collection-reuse-name (truncated label). The strip's height is now fixed regardless of entry count -- 10 entries render at the identical height as 1 -- structurally decoupling the Inspector panel's height from Collection size forever. Verified via a new, dedicated Playwright suite (collection_picker_layout_verify.js, 13/13 assertions, zero console/page errors), including the decisive proof: strip height with 10 Collection entries is byte-identical (89px) to height with 1 entry. A real test-authoring gotcha was found and worked around, disclosed in the test's own comments: .wb-content-kind-btn's click handler has a genuine no-op guard on re-clicking an already-active kind, requiring a two-Experience test design rather than re-clicking the same button twice. The pre-existing collection_phase2_verify.js suite needed 3 stale selectors updated to match the new DOM shape -- re-verified 28/28 passing, unchanged behaviour underneath. Full regression: collection_directadd_verify.js (19/19), the Collection Phase 1 (27/27), Phase 3 (25/25), Phase 4 (17/17), Phase 5 (30/30), and Phase 6 (13/13) suites all pass completely unchanged, plus both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2, both PASS). No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; root Studio (Creator) and tools/world-builder/ (v1) are both completely untouched -- confined entirely to tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js and tools/world-builder-v2/css/world-builder.css.
